metadata.title: Build and publish the guided product tour

spec.objective: Build a separately published static guided tour using actual Kontor presentation, coherent historical devnet evidence and no network mutations; verify mobile, keyboard, source boundaries and public deployment.
acceptance: Guided causal replay works on desktop and mobile using real UI
No API/RPC/signing or private runtime data in public tour
Recorded proof identities match the selected scenario and public Pages URL works
Independent source-aware verification and fresh browser review retained
